deliverables: Milestone-based disbursement controls through TRSC and PSSC smart contracts
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor Teragone
request.what: Withdraw treasury funds for Mithril Protocol continuous development through Intersect budget process administration and smart contract management.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,810,423 ada, consisting of 3,699,440 ada for Mithril Protocol Continuous Development and 110,983 ada for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Mithril is described as using stake-based threshold multi-signatures to certify Cardano state trustlessly, enabling faster state verification without relying on the entire chain.
The proposer states that full node synchronization is slow and light clients currently rely on centralized trust, creating a pressing infrastructure challenge for Cardano.
The proposal claims Mithril is fully aligned with Infrastructure & Research Excellence and Adoption & Utility, and partially aligned with Community & Ecosystem Growth.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to Hydra voting records, documentation, final audited results, and an audit report.
The proposer states the requested withdrawal does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 and links to the related governance action.

Audit, administrative oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are described as being covered through Intersect overhead and independent oversight by Intersect and technically capable third parties.
The proposal states Teragone has not previously received direct Cardano treasury or community governance funding, but has worked on Mithril for several years through IOG-funded collaboration.

Intersect plans to administer funds using Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts, with named TRSC and PSSC addresses, role-based authorization thresholds, an oversight committee, audits, GitHub repository, documentation, and a public dashboard referenced.
Upon enactment, funds will be directed to the TRSC stake address, later transferred to the PSSC when the legal contract is prepared and the vendor is ready, with milestones outlined within metadata.

summary: The document requests 3,810,423 ada for continued Mithril Protocol development and Intersect administration, presenting Mithril as decentralizing infrastructure, citing budget-process approval and NCL compliance, and describing smart-contract-based treasury custody, oversight, and disbursement processes.
